answer: An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the timber index resolves every citation against the jetty checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the horizon audit keeps the resolved set. The per-identity price is 108 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
